title: The edge map path loses its two force unwraps and its unchecked Sendable
goal: Two spots in the measurement code crash rather than fail gracefully if their assumptions ever break, and one core type opts out of the compiler's thread-safety checks. Remove all three so the measure tools keep the repo's safety rules.
notes: Sources/PhotonzCore/EdgeMap.swift:79 (luma!.count), Sources/PhotonzRender/EdgeMapAnalyzer.swift:103 (CGColorSpace(name:)!), Sources/PhotonzCore/SelectionRegion.swift:12 (@unchecked Sendable). CLAUDE.md: no force unwraps in core or render; core must be value-typed and Sendable. Shared code, both releases.
acceptance: No force unwrap remains in Sources/PhotonzCore or Sources/PhotonzRender (the grep in the task log shows zero hits), behavior unchanged, tests green.
SelectionRegion in PhotonzCore is Sendable without @unchecked, or carries a comment explaining exactly why it cannot be.
ElementDetectionFixtureTests and AlignmentFixtureTests still pin the same numbers.

log.note: Adversarial review: pure engineering hygiene, no UX surface, no decision needed. Checked the third item honestly: a Sendable struct holding a CGPath fails Swift 6 strict-concurrency typechecking on this SDK, so the annotation cannot be removed without storing path elements as values and rebuilding a CGPath on every contains/bounds call (marching ants, fill clipping); acceptance item 2's comment route taken.

Tests first: EdgeMapLumaTests (wrong-size luma yields empty map, right size keeps it), SelectionRegionTests.regionHoldsAnIndependentCopyOfAMutableSourcePath. Dropped an `is CGMutablePath` assertion: CGPath and CGMutablePath share a CFTypeID so it is always true.

EdgeMap.swift: `(luma?.count ?? width * height) == width * height`. EdgeMapAnalyzer.swift: `let srgb = CGColorSpace(name:)` joins the guard chain. SelectionRegion.swift: precise comment on why @unchecked stays; init now fails when path.copy() fails instead of retaining the caller's path.

grep -rnE '[A-Za-z0-9_\)\]]![^=]' Sources/PhotonzCore Sources/PhotonzRender | grep -vE '!=|"[^"]*!'  => 0 hits. Scripts/test.sh: 1181 tests in 148 suites passed; ElementDetectionFixtureTests and AlignmentFixtureTests untouched and green.
